final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS k, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS r FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.r) AS avg_rate_above, AVG(g.r - b.m) AS avg_excess FROM g, b WHERE g.r > b.m
